messages:
Sam H: Quick check — planning to enable feature flag `burst_queueing_v2` in canary for 5% of traffic (audience tag: `beta-scaler`) tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need eng-platform + SRE ack and for oncall to be aware. Any objections?

Lina M: Can we scope the canary to eu-west first? Last NA test created noticeable queue spikes even with small %s.

Gabe R: SGTM for EU-only. Also propose we set `max_concurrency_guardrail: 120` on the canary workers and a soft ramp (1% -> 5% over 10m).

Mira K: I'll open the rollout PR and add the audience + ramp. Also adding metric hooks: `in_flight`, `p99_latency_ms`, `queue_length`. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/capacity-guardrails 

Sam H: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4212 — includes EU-only targeting, ramp 1->5% over 10m, and guardrail config. Deploy window 09:00-10:30 PST. Monitoring plan: watch p99, queue_length, error_rate. Auto-disable if `error_rate > 0.5%` sustained for 5m.

ops-sre: oncall FYI ^ — please make sure incident templates are ready.

oncall-bot: Alerting policy "capacity-guardrail" will notify #eng-oncall if `queue_length > 500` or `error_rate > 0.5%` for 5m.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary toggle: `burst_queueing_v2` -> 2026-06-15T09:00:00-07:00 (unix 1862469000). Holding until explicit SRE ack.

Gabe R: ACK from me. Confirm fallback behaviour: toggle auto-reverts if guardrail triggers? Need explicit statement in PR.

Lina M: ACK as well. +1 to the ramp rather than flat 5% immediately. Also recommend enabling verbose metrics for first 30m.

Mira K: Added fallback snippet in PR and a small config excerpt: 
```
canary: 
  audience: beta-scaler
  regions: [eu-west-1]
  rollout: [1%, 5% over 10m]
  guardrails: 
    max_concurrency: 120
    error_rate_threshold: 0.005 
    queue_length_threshold: 500
```

Sam H: Tagging watchers @Mira K @Gabe R @Lina M @ops-sre. I'll run the pre-roll checklist 08:30 PST and post a short status update in this thread.

Mira K: I'll be on watch for the window. Will escalate to oncall if queue_length trends up. +1

Gabe R: One last ask — add a short smoke test for cold-cache latency after enabling. Can we gate it in the runbook?

Sam H: Good call — added smoke test step to the runbook and PR. If there are no objections I will press the schedule button tomorrow at 08:40.

Lina M: No objections from me.

ops-sre: Thanks — noted. Will be ready to respond if alerts fire.

Sam H: Summary: EU-only canary, 1% -> 5% ramp, max_concurrency 120, auto-disable on error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, monitor p99/queue_length. PR linked above. Scheduling tomorrow 09:00 PST.
